Morteza Nikoubazl / NurPhoto via Getty ShareAdd NBC News to GoogleNov. 24, 2026, 11:00 AM ESTBy Gordon Lubold and Courtney KubeWASHINGTON — Trump administration officials are internally debating whether the U.S. military should target top Iranian leaders in an attempt to remove so-called hardliners from the regime, according to a U.S. official and a person with knowledge of the discussions.
